title: SecurityEvent
description: Canonical event schema for Nexora. Every module (simulator, detection, correlation, backend, frontend) must produce/consume events matching this exact shape. This file is the single source of truth; the backend Pydantic model (backend/app/schemas.py) and the frontend TypeScript types (frontend/src/types/nexora.ts) mirror it, and tests assert they stay in sync.

id.description: Stable unique id for the event. Optional on the wire from the simulator; the pipeline assigns one if missing. Correlation needs it to key graph nodes.

user.description: Username or user ID. Use 'unknown' if unauthenticated.

session.description: Session ID. Group related events under the same session.

severity.description: Normalized severity, 0.0 (benign) to 1.0 (critical). Agreed as a float 0-1, not a 1-5 int scale.

anomaly_score.description: Detection-engine anomaly score, 0.0 (normal) to 1.0 (highly anomalous). Null until the detector has scored the event.

attack_label.description: Classifier output. 'benign' or one of the scoped attack types (brute_force, port_scan, data_exfiltration, api_abuse). Null until classified.

flagged.description: True once the detection engine marks the event anomalous/attack. Correlation only chains flagged events.

metadata.description: Optional event-type-specific extra fields (e.g. endpoint, query, filename). Keep required fields above minimal and put anything module-specific here so the contract doesn't change every time someone needs one more field.
